s02219.summary: Strangers do laundry at dawn; Martha fusses over Kayla's socks and Arturo's broken machine.
Solange enters in a muddy black dress with a bag of clothes and starts a wash.
Desiree sympathizes; Martha quietly offers Solange a folded pillowcase, and Solange sits beside her.

s00061.summary: In a rain-soaked trench, Penrose and Onwuachi check on men and a trembling private.
A whistle blows, the trench erupts over the top, and Onwuachi drags frozen Elias with him.

s00884.summary: Kaelen wades into a drowned library, where pale Selune rises and Old Bram whittles.
Kaelen and Selune clash over the Index, each claiming it, until Bram mocks their certainty.
Kaelen asks to read one page, her mother's, and Selune softens.
Selune hands her the book; its single line shows her mother waited every night.
Old Bram drops down from his shelf and offers tea.

s01863.summary: Agent Maren offers Theo water and coffee; he refuses and corrects her on the hours.
Maren asks about the drive in his sock; his smile fades and he denies having it.
She slides a photo, takes his hand, and finds a locker stamp's ink on his palm.
Maren closes the folder and, at the door, suggests coffee; Theo asks for black.

s01163.summary: Dr. Falk and her team fight to stabilize a crashing patient, with a shaky resident.
The monitor flatlines; Falk defibrillates and gets a rhythm before he codes again.
Dr. Ashford takes over from Falk and shocks the patient back.

s01278.summary: Odette, the ticket agent, plays an old tape of herself recording memories.
The tape says she was happiest in the booth; Odette murmurs 'Happier' and stares at the dark pier.
The recording urges her to go to the sea; she cuts it off and throws her cap.
She pockets the cassette, switches off the lamp, and steps into the fog.

s00317.summary: Coach Marisol pushes tired Isaura to swim another length on the early-morning deck.
Isaura launches and Marisol paces the lane, shouting 'Long' until she touches the wall.
Marisol times a two-tenths improvement; they sit and talk about quitting and getting up.
They say 'Again' together, laugh, and rise for another swim.

s00075.summary: A four-person crew breaks into a cheese cave and Sunita picks a cabinet lock.
The cabinet opens on jars of centuries-old starter cultures and they load the duffel.
Madame Thibault enters with a shotgun and orders them to put everything back.
They comply; Madame Thibault says she left the cabinet unlocked for mice.

s02511.summary: Patrollers and a lost guest relax in the warm hut; Isadora insists the sign was misplaced.
Base reports the only Isadora Vance checked out at noon; the guest's smile never changes.
Isadora reveals a hospital bracelet and says she did not make it down.
As Thorvald grips a probe, she recalls the east chute eleven years ago and the stove dies.

s01570.summary: Inspector Okafor probes taxidermist Elias about Sunday night and a missing woman.
Okafor says Mrs. Delacroix mentioned a second ledger hidden inside a badger.
Elias lunges for the shelf; Okafor tackles him and they struggle over a scalpel.
The badger falls and splits open, spilling paper across the floor.

s00341.summary: Three soldiers keep tense silent watch from the bell tower at dawn.
Hosseini tells Command nothing moves while Mbeki whispers the line.
A metal clink in the fog, apparently from the church, and a bell suddenly tolls.

s01246.summary: In a burnt-pancake morning, Barnaby refuses to go as Rosemary juggles a call with Grandma.
On the phone, Barnaby admits he won't run his sports day race because he always loses.
Grandma tells how Grandpa lost every race and enjoyed it; Barnaby almost smiles.
Rosemary laughs through tears at Grandma's burnt pancake advice and says she loves her.
She serves Barnaby the burnt pancake; he eats it and reaches for his shoe.

s00100.summary: Five siblings squabble on auction day over who gets the clock.
Kirsten admits taking their mother's blue quilt, which she says Ma promised her.
Ivo sits and rules the clock goes to whoever winds it; Anselm says he does.
Kirsten spreads the quilt and the siblings recall the barn and pump house together.

s00466.summary: Dr. Hellebore visits after hours demanding to know about foxglove dispensed to Mrs. Pennywhistle.
Ezekiel says Augustus prescribed a teaspoon, not a pinch; Augustus denies it.
Nellie produces the prescription slip in his own hand and holds her ground.
Augustus drops his polite mask, threatens Ezekiel, and storms out into the rain.
Ezekiel praises Nellie for keeping the slip, which he taught her.

s02204.summary: An ambulance brings in farmer Marcel, in chest pain and hypotensive, to a rural ER.
Marcel goes into V-fib; Amara and Ben shock him until a pulse returns.
Dispatch asks for another run; Fiona, after thirty-one sleepless hours, accepts as they joke.
Marcel wakes and apologizes for the trouble; Amara and Ben wheel him inside.

s01676.summary: Crew members shout over a venting greenhouse seal; the captain orders Rack Nine cut loose.
Barnaby slams the lever, the warning light dies, and everyone exhales.

s01511.summary: Ken greets his two bored employees with a laminated SYNERGY sign.
Ken calls the closure a 'realignment' and a 'hybrid model' as Beatrix and Manny press him.
Ken drops the sign; all three collide and tumble, quipping about team-building.

s02287.summary: Armed Celeste silently descends toward Isaac, a mechanic on a ladder in an elevator shaft.
Isaac calmly answers his radio under her gun, then drops it down the shaft.
She fires; Isaac swings off the ladder and drops onto a rising counterweight.
The counterweight sinks away from her; Isaac lies shaking and laughing silently.

s00900.summary: Constable Oakes brings a gentleman without a letter to bookkeeper Henrietta at night.
Henrietta demands his name and business; Blackwood claims her employer owes him a sum.
She spots the forged paper by a looped T; Blackwood's hand drifts toward his coat.
Henrietta locks the paper away and has Oakes escort Blackwood out; her pen stays steady.

s02065.summary: Execs bicker over a pilot win and vague roadmap numbers while HR pleads for civility.
The rumpled CEO Bart wanders in asking for coffee and who is winning.
Bart chews a croissant, then brings up the layoffs while everyone watches.

s02197.summary: Captain Callista and Rook spot the pirate ship Duskmaw turning at dawn.
Callista jokes about running and tells Rook to let the Duskmaw close, then drop the ballast.

s01904.summary: Princess Astrid strides into the dragon's library and finds her mother unwelcoming.
Astrid presses her mother about the dragon; Isolde says he asked her to read ledgers.
Isolde says the dragon asks about Astrid's sister; Astrid has none; the fire shrinks.
Isolde tells Astrid to sit and bring the ledger for a long story.

s00077.summary: Nell laces a skate in the empty rink while Soledad circles, silent.
Soledad reminds Nell she promised to tell her something, then skates off angrily.
Nell says she is leaving and Soledad stops, stunned.
Soledad throws her skate; Nell brings it back and offers it, but Soledad does not take it.

s02401.summary: Four siblings and Dev bicker in a camper van at a drive-in; Ansel hides under a sleeping bag.
Their mother calls and the sisters fib about the movie until she asks about Ansel.
Ansel says hi and is ordered home; they all burst into helpless laughter.

s00119.summary: A bakery truck crew does a radio check on their handcuffed captive stranger.
The stranger offers double pay; Mari and Hector brush him off.
Hector opens the case and finds the dossier naming the stranger as auditor Julian Ashworth-Mbeki.
They argue over whether they got the right man; croissants spill and Julian suggests eating.

s02399.summary: Grandma Winnifred sews while Jasper and Lotte quietly help in the sunny room.
Jasper asks how old the machine is and Gran says she's as old; the needle thuds on.

s01481.summary: Elias sorts soldiers' letters into egg-crate pigeonholes in a requisitioned schoolroom.
One letter gives him pause; he hears its news of the pear tree and a promise kept.
He writes RETURNED on it, erases it, and wipes the blackboard to the nines.
He puts the letter in the highest pigeonhole and says 'Not today'.

s01572.summary: Priya folds towels while Dev says a strange teen claims to be his cousin.
Priya accepts him as Aunt Lena's son Kofi, and Mrs. Abernathy calls them a lovely family.
Kofi says he'll stay a week; Priya agrees and Dev grins.
